strategy_name: VOLB DSI30 long-only regime follower with entry-spread cap (NOT QUALIFIED)
one_line: Screen of 49 continuous Deriv synthetics found only Drift Switch regime momentum; its DSI30 long-only edge (+4.9 pts/trade gross) is consumed by a drift-linked dynamic spread (PF 0.41 at the widest observed 10.16).

logic.entry: long when efficiency ratio of last 6 closed M5 bars > 0.8 and live spread <= cap (cBot); no entries on bars stamped 18:50-21:05 UTC
logic.exit: trailing stop 1.5 x ATR20 (ratchets on bar closes) or time exit after 24 bars (2 h)
logic.stop: hard SL 2.5 x ATR20 attached to every order
logic.sizing: broker minimum 0.10 units (optional risk-% capped in the cBot)
logic.risk: one position, daily loss limit, equity kill-switch 25 %, pause after 8 consecutive losses, spread cap 4.0

parameters.name: max_spread (cBot)
parameters.meaning: entry spread cap, not modelled in backtest

rejected_alternatives.result: VolSwMed 21% sets PF>1, none >1.2; Step/V75(1s) hits on 35-68 trades within null p90

rejected_alternatives.result: max IS t 2.41 over 40 sets/symbol, corr(IS,OOS)~0
